name: read-along
title: Read Along
description: Words light up at reading speed. Pause or step through them individually.
useCases: In a language lesson, a learner starts word-by-word highlighting and pauses at a difficult phrase.
When rehearsing a short speech, a speaker selects a word midway through the text and resumes at the chosen pace.
task: Words light up at reading speed. Pause or step through them individually.
behavior: Pass the full passage. interval sets the delay between words in milliseconds, with a minimum of 120.
